units.source_text: “这是最好的棋子吧，让我来掂掂看。”

en.t: These must be the finest stones; let me weigh them in my hand.

units.source_text: 说着，抓起一把放在掌心上端详。

en.t: As he said this, he picked up a handful, placed them on his palm, and examined them closely.

units.source_text: 这样的对局，倘使能让棋手在自己棋盘上下一手，就是在棋盘上镀一层金。

en.t: In a match like this, if one could have the player make even a single move on one's own board, it was like gilding the board with a layer of gold.

units.source_text: 因而人们总愿意把心爱的棋盘送来，不管送多少个。

en.t: For that reason, people were always eager to bring their cherished boards, no matter how many they sent in.
